text:
Maya Chen: FYI Opal Insights asked to onboard a small-footprint summarization/navigation model for customer support transcripts. They want PHI-safe extraction, chunked summarization, and fast semantic search. POC timeline: 3 weeks. Go-live target: 8 weeks. Renewal conversation next quarter — flagged as medium risk if we miss timeline.
Arjun Patel: Can you paste the ask doc? Need to know QPS, latency SLOs, and whether they require Private (VPC/HSM) or Hosted.
Maya Chen: Copying key bits from the intake form: QPS ~20 steady with 50 spike, 95p latency <150ms for short summaries, prefer on-prem/private due to PHI, must support HSM for key wraps, and embeddings for rerank. They want cost estimate + perf baseline on 13B/7B options.
Leo Morales: For latency/cost tradeoff: 7B int8-quant + KV cache might hit 95p ~120ms on A10X style nodes for short sequences. 13B will need larger memory and different batching. We should run a microbenchmark.
Priya Singh: PHI checklist: need tokenization audit, deterministic redaction + model output filtering, and HSM-backed key storage. Also need an audit log of inference inputs/outputs — if they insist on on-prem we can offer Private with customer-managed logging.
Arjun Patel: Can we propose a staged rollout: hosted POC with synthetic PHI (sanitized) -> dedicated private deployment for integration tests -> on-prem final if required? That shortens initial delivery.
Maya Chen: Opal explicitly prefers private/on-prem from legal, but they'd accept hosted for POC if contractually sanitized. They want a safety eval harness that includes adversarial prompts and privacy-preserving redaction checks.
Leo Morales: I'll scope an eval harness. Plan: sample set of 250 transcripts, adversarial perturbations (PII insertion, role-play prompts), and automated metrics for hallucination + PHI leakage. Output format from harness: JSONL rows with fields: prompt, output, leakage_flag, rouge/bleu where applicable.
Arjun Patel: Need infrastructure ask for SRE: estimated GPU RAM + nodes for 20 QPS. @deploy-bot can you schedule a capacity estimate run with the runtime team? :eyes:
deploy-bot: Scheduled capacity-run job opal-insights-2026-04-03 02:00 UTC. Results will be posted in #eng-runtime.
Priya Singh: Also need to confirm encryption-in-transit & at-rest configs. If customer requires HSM, we need to list supported vendors (AWS CloudHSM, Azure KeyVault + HSM wrap, on-prem HSM options).
Maya Chen: I'll collect legal language for POC-sanitization. Action list: (1) Arjun to draft POC deployment plan (hosted sanitized) by EOD Fri; (2) Leo to produce eval harness spec by Tue; (3) Priya to list HSM/compliance items + minimal audit log schema by Wed; (4) SRE/runtime to run capacity job and post numbers after deploy-bot run.
Arjun Patel: Draft plan note: POC config example to share with Opal — minimal model config we propose:
```json
{
  "model": "redwood-7b-int8",
  "mode": "inference",
  "batching": {
    "max_tokens": 256,
    "max_batch_size": 8,
    "latency_target_ms": 120
  },
  "kv_cache": true,
  "quantization": "int8"
}
```
Maya Chen: Quick ask from CS: Opal's account health shows rising support tickets for integration docs. Can someone from docs/devex join the POC kickoff? We should capture early feedback to avoid churn at renewal.
Leo Morales: I'll loop in @DevX lead after I finish the harness spec. Also recommend we capture qualitative feedback in a short survey after each POC run (3 questions: accuracy, latency satisfaction, integration pain).
Priya Singh: For the safety eval, add a manual review step: 5% random outputs to be human-reviewed for PHI leakage. Document retention for those review artifacts needs retention policy — propose 90 days.
Maya Chen: Noted. Renewal risk: I logged a note in the CRM and set a flag for quarterly exec sync if we slip >2 weeks on POC start. Will share that with AE.
Arjun Patel: OK starting the POC draft now. Will ask Opal for sample transcripts redacted via a secure upload link. Maya, can you confirm whether they can use our S3 presigned flow or need direct SFTP?
Maya Chen: They prefer SFTP for legal, but can accept presigned with contractual addendum. I'll confirm and update the thread.
deploy-bot: POC kickoff meeting created: 2026-04-05 15:00 UTC — invites sent to Maya, Arjun, Leo, Priya.
Maya Chen: Thanks all — keeping this thread as the single source of truth. I'll post intake doc + legal note once confirmed. :white_check_mark:
